verdict.rationale: All evidence for Visa Intelligent Commerce and its Trusted Agent Protocol comes from Visa's own docs, blog, and GitHub repos (visa/trusted-agent-protocol, visaacceptance/agent-toolkit); there is no evidence of a second independent party (another payment network, merchant platform, or third-party vendor) implementing the protocol/platform itself. Community commentary even flags the ecosystem as premature and missing standardized agent identity, reinforcing the absence of independent implementers.
